title: Voxel
description: A club photograph printed flat on a pale studio floor, made of two thousand satin cubes. Tap it and the pixels rise in a ripple, tip over and pour into a mosaic heap beside the print; stir the heap by hand, then call every cube back to its slot.
intent: One material mechanic finished to the edge: a photograph you can knock into a pile of its own pixels and put back together, each cube carrying its patch of the image so the heap reads as a mosaic of the picture.
